description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for a WebSocket endpoint within a specific project, including methods for retrieving configuration parameters, rendering configuration into a Config object, and an enum for default config values.

classes.name: WebsocketConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration methods and default values for WebSocket connections, including buffer sizes, throttling factors, and rendering configuration into a Config object.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum queue size for inflight commands per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size for outstanding command responses and events per WebSocket client.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Returns the factor of maximum throughput at which rejections are sent.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the throttling configuration for WebSocket.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Serializes the WebSocket configuration into a Typesafe Config object, including the settings and throttling configuration.
